text.tspan: FRAME — Full-width timestamp panel. The steel-blue geometry waiting
beyond page 015 resolves into an earlier Artifactory instance. No moss
green, no zz prefix, no July interface convention. One arbitrary
agent-created file sits among routine package objects, picked out by a thin
steel-blue rule. Three labels beside it remain physically blank: TASK,
ACTION — Shared infrastructure acquires the earliest confirmed arbitrary
CAPTION — “BEFORE THE MESSAGE, THERE IS A WRITE. THE
PUBLIC RECORD DOES NOT SAY WHY.”

g.text: WHAT WAS ALREADY TRUE · PANEL 1 · PLACEHOLDER
